CERT_EXPIRED.title: Expired signing certificate
CERT_EXPIRED.description: APK signed with an expired certificate.

MANIFEST_DEBUGGABLE.title: Application is debuggable
MANIFEST_DEBUGGABLE.description: android:debuggable=true allows attaching a debugger and inspecting memory/state.
MANIFEST_DEBUGGABLE.recommendation: Remove android:debuggable or set to false in release builds.

MANIFEST_BACKUP.title: Backup allowed
MANIFEST_BACKUP.description: android:allowBackup enables extraction of private app storage via adb backup.

MANIFEST_CLEARTEXT.title: Cleartext traffic permitted
MANIFEST_CLEARTEXT.recommendation: Set to false and use HTTPS everywhere.

MANIFEST_LOW_TARGET_SDK.title: Low targetSdkVersion
MANIFEST_LOW_TARGET_SDK.description: App targets an older Android SDK, missing modern security defaults.

PERMISSION_LOCATION.title: Location permission requested
PERMISSION_LOCATION.description: App requests access to device location.
PERMISSION_LOCATION.recommendation: Only request if essential; prefer foreground-only.

PERMISSION_STORAGE.title: Storage permission requested
PERMISSION_STORAGE.description: App requests access to external storage.
PERMISSION_STORAGE.recommendation: Use scoped storage APIs; avoid broad access.

PERMISSION_SMS.title: SMS permission requested
PERMISSION_SMS.recommendation: Avoid unless functionally required; consider SMS Retriever API.

PERMISSION_CONTACTS.title: Contacts permission requested
PERMISSION_CONTACTS.recommendation: Restrict and justify clearly in UI.

PERMISSION_CAMERA.title: Camera permission requested
PERMISSION_CAMERA.recommendation: Use only when required and on user action.

PERMISSION_MIC.title: Microphone permission requested
PERMISSION_MIC.recommendation: Prompt user; stop recording in background.

PERMISSION_PHONE.title: Phone permission requested
PERMISSION_PHONE.description: App can read phone state or place calls.

PERMISSION_SENSORS.title: Sensor permission requested
PERMISSION_SENSORS.recommendation: Only request if core to function.

COMPONENT_ACTIVITY.title: Exported activity
COMPONENT_ACTIVITY.description: An activity is exported and reachable by other apps.
COMPONENT_ACTIVITY.recommendation: Set android:exported="false" or protect with permission.

COMPONENT_SERVICE.title: Exported service
COMPONENT_SERVICE.description: A service is exported and reachable by other apps.
COMPONENT_SERVICE.recommendation: Set android:exported="false" or protect with signature permission.

COMPONENT_RECEIVER.title: Exported receiver
COMPONENT_RECEIVER.description: A broadcast receiver is exported and reachable by other apps.

COMPONENT_PROVIDER.title: Exported content provider
COMPONENT_PROVIDER.description: A content provider is exported and reachable by other apps.
COMPONENT_PROVIDER.recommendation: Set android:exported="false" or protect with android:permission.

COMPONENT_LAUNCHER.title: Launcher activity
COMPONENT_LAUNCHER.description: Main activity with MAIN/LAUNCHER intent-filter — exported by design and required for app launching.
COMPONENT_LAUNCHER.recommendation: Informational only; this is expected behaviour.

DEEPLINK_WILDCARD_HOST.title: Wildcard deep-link host
DEEPLINK_WILDCARD_HOST.description: A browsable intent-filter uses a wildcard/empty host.
DEEPLINK_WILDCARD_HOST.recommendation: Use explicit hosts and validate deep-link parameters.

DEEPLINK_HTTP.title: HTTP deep link
DEEPLINK_HTTP.description: Deep link uses an http scheme; vulnerable to interception.
DEEPLINK_HTTP.recommendation: Use https and App Links with assetlink.json.

SECRET_AWS_KEY.title: AWS access key
SECRET_AWS_KEY.description: AWS access key embedded in APK.
SECRET_AWS_KEY.recommendation: Rotate key immediately; use short-lived tokens from backend.

SECRET_GOOGLE_API.title: Google API key
SECRET_GOOGLE_API.description: Google API key embedded in APK.
SECRET_GOOGLE_API.recommendation: Restrict key by Android package/SHA-1; rotate if abused.

SECRET_PRIVATE_KEY.title: Private key detected
SECRET_PRIVATE_KEY.description: PEM-encoded private key found in APK.

SECRET_STRIPE.title: Stripe live key
SECRET_STRIPE.description: Stripe live key embedded in APK.

SECRET_IP_ADDRESS.title: Hardcoded IP address
SECRET_IP_ADDRESS.recommendation: Verify it points to expected backend.

SECRET_OBFUSCATED_BLOB.title: Possible obfuscated blob
SECRET_OBFUSCATED_BLOB.description: A long hex string (>=24 chars) is present in the DEX. This may be an encryption key, an obfuscated secret, or simply a hash. Manual review recommended.
SECRET_OBFUSCATED_BLOB.recommendation: Inspect the string in-context (jadx) to determine if it is a secret.

SECRET_IN_NATIVE.title: Secret pattern found in native library
SECRET_IN_NATIVE.description: A credential-like string was found inside a .so file bundled in the APK.
SECRET_IN_NATIVE.recommendation: Remove secrets from native code; rotate if present.

CODE_WEAK_CRYPTO_ECB.title: AES/ECB mode
CODE_WEAK_CRYPTO_ECB.description: ECB mode is deterministic and insecure.

CODE_WEAK_HASH_MD5.title: MD5 hash
CODE_WEAK_HASH_MD5.description: MD5 is broken for security use.

CODE_WEAK_HASH_SHA1.title: SHA-1 hash
CODE_WEAK_HASH_SHA1.description: SHA-1 is deprecated for security use.

CODE_INSECURE_RANDOM.title: java.util.Random
CODE_INSECURE_RANDOM.description: Non-cryptographic RNG used for security purposes.

CODE_TRUST_ALL_CERTS.title: Insecure TrustManager
CODE_TRUST_ALL_CERTS.description: Custom TrustManager may accept all certs.

RESILIENCE_ROOT_CHECK_PRESENT.title: Root detection implemented
RESILIENCE_ROOT_CHECK_PRESENT.description: Application checks whether the device is rooted. This is a positive control that can be tested for bypass during a lab assessment.
RESILIENCE_ROOT_CHECK_PRESENT.recommendation: None; for crackme targets this is the first obstacle to bypass.

RESILIENCE_FRIDA_CHECK_PRESENT.title: Frida detection implemented
RESILIENCE_FRIDA_CHECK_PRESENT.description: Application looks for Frida instrumentation. Positive control — may be bypassable.

RESILIENCE_XPOSED_CHECK_PRESENT.title: Xposed detection implemented
RESILIENCE_XPOSED_CHECK_PRESENT.description: Application looks for Xposed framework. Positive control.

RESILIENCE_DEBUG_CHECK_PRESENT.title: Debug detection implemented
RESILIENCE_DEBUG_CHECK_PRESENT.description: Application checks for debugger attachment. Positive control.

RESILIENCE_EMULATOR_CHECK_PRESENT.title: Emulator detection implemented
RESILIENCE_EMULATOR_CHECK_PRESENT.description: Application checks for emulator artefacts. Positive control.

STORAGE_WORLD_READABLE.title: World-readable file mode
STORAGE_WORLD_READABLE.description: MODE_WORLD_READABLE exposes files to other apps.

STORAGE_WORLD_WRITEABLE.title: World-writable file mode
STORAGE_WORLD_WRITEABLE.description: MODE_WORLD_WRITEABLE allows other apps to write files.

STORAGE_LOG_SENSITIVE.title: Sensitive data logged
STORAGE_LOG_SENSITIVE.description: Log call includes sensitive variable names.

NETWORK_NO_CONFIG.title: No network security config
NETWORK_NO_CONFIG.description: App does not define networkSecurityConfig while also having network capability.

NETWORK_HTTP_URL.title: HTTP URL hardcoded
NETWORK_HTTP_URL.description: Plain HTTP endpoint found in DEX.

RUNTIME_CRASH.title: Crash detected at runtime
RUNTIME_CRASH.description: App logged a FATAL EXCEPTION during observation.
RUNTIME_CRASH.recommendation: Investigate crash; may indicate input validation bugs.

WEBVIEW_JS_BRIDGE.title: WebView JS Bridge
WEBVIEW_JS_BRIDGE.description: Application exposes native Java objects to JavaScript via addJavascriptInterface. If the WebView loads untrusted content, this can lead to RCE.
WEBVIEW_JS_BRIDGE.recommendation: Avoid addJavascriptInterface. Use WebViewCompat and restrict allowed origins.

WEBVIEW_FILE_ACCESS.title: WebView File Access
WEBVIEW_FILE_ACCESS.description: WebView allows local file access, which can lead to data exfiltration if the app loads a malicious URL.
WEBVIEW_FILE_ACCESS.recommendation: Disable file access unless strictly necessary.

WEBVIEW_UNIVERSAL_ACCESS.title: WebView Universal Access
WEBVIEW_UNIVERSAL_ACCESS.description: WebView allows JavaScript from file:// URLs to access any origin.

CLOUD_S3_BUCKET_FOUND.title: AWS S3 Bucket URL
CLOUD_S3_BUCKET_FOUND.description: An S3 bucket URL was found in the APK. Check if the bucket is public or lacks proper IAM policies.
CLOUD_S3_BUCKET_FOUND.recommendation: Ensure S3 buckets require authenticated access and block public listing.

CLOUD_FIREBASE_OPEN.title: Publicly Readable Firebase
CLOUD_FIREBASE_OPEN.description: A Firebase database URL allows unauthenticated read access.
CLOUD_FIREBASE_OPEN.recommendation: Update Firebase security rules to require authentication.

INFO_DEEPLINK_PAYLOAD.title: Deep Link Payload
INFO_DEEPLINK_PAYLOAD.description: ADB command generated to test this deep link.
INFO_DEEPLINK_PAYLOAD.recommendation: Use the provided payload to test for parameter injection or unauthorized screen access.

DEEPLINK_BROWSABLE.title: Browsable activity exposed
DEEPLINK_BROWSABLE.description: An activity with a BROWSABLE intent-filter can be launched from a browser or another app via deep links, potentially exposing functionality to untrusted callers.
DEEPLINK_BROWSABLE.recommendation: Validate all deep link parameters server-side. Use App Links with assetlinks.json for verified domains.

RUNTIME_PREF_PASSWORD.title: Password stored in SharedPreferences
RUNTIME_PREF_PASSWORD.description: Frida detected a password-like value being saved to SharedPreferences at runtime, indicating insecure credential storage.
RUNTIME_PREF_PASSWORD.recommendation: Use Android Keystore or EncryptedSharedPreferences for sensitive data. Never store passwords in plaintext.

RUNTIME_CRYPTO.title: Crypto operation observed at runtime
RUNTIME_CRYPTO.description: Frida intercepted a Cipher.doFinal() call at runtime. Review the algorithm and mode for weak crypto (e.g. ECB, DES).
RUNTIME_CRYPTO.recommendation: Ensure AES/GCM or AES/CBC with HMAC is used. Avoid ECB mode and legacy ciphers.
